mapper.select: SELECT t.peer_id AS peerId, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, t.last_id AS lastMessageId, m.content AS lastContent, t.last_time AS lastTime, t.unread AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT peer_id, MAX(id) AS last_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_time, SUM(CASE WHEN x.to_user_id = #{uid} AND x.is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread FROM ( SELECT id, created_at, to_user_id, is_read, IF(from_user_id = #{uid}, to_user_id, from_user_id) AS peer_id FROM t_chat_message WHERE from_user_id = #{uid} OR to_user_id = #{uid} ) x GROUP BY peer_id ) t JOIN t_user u ON u.id = t.peer_id JOIN t_chat_message m ON m.id = t.last_id ORDER BY t.last_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{uid} AND is_read = 0
